primitives.verbatim_quote: Unlike the third baseman, however, he cannot be allowed to take everything he can get in the in-field; for, as a rule, he must not go farther from his base than to a point from which he can return to the bag in time to intercept the runner.

primitives.name: Ground Hit Handling Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: The first baseman's most regular work is catching thrown balls; but he has other duties by no means unimportant, chief among which is handling ground-hits.
primitives.assumptions: Ground hits require immediate response and precise catch mechanics.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure to secure ground hit due to misalignment or delay.
